thread:
maria: Heads-up — starting rollout for routing v3 + session pinning now. Client-side canary: 1% -> 5% -> 10% over ~30m. Feature flag name: routing_v3_client.

deploy-bot: Deploy job #deploy_2026-312 started for service=router, image=router:v3. Rolling update across 4 zones. See CI: https://ci.redwood/dep/2026-312

sam: Quick question — are we pinning sessions server-side or leaving client header?

maria: Server pins by session_id for 30m, and we also send X-Route-Pin header so clients can stick if they want.

jonah: Telemetry gates? What are the hard stop conditions?

maria: p95 latency > 150ms OR error rate > 1.5x baseline for the cohort -> automated pause + rollback. Also manual override if we see request mismatches.

ops: Clarify cadence: 1% for 10m, then 5% for 10m, then 10% steady?

maria: Yep — 1% (10m) -> 5% (10m) -> 10% (rest of window). If stable for 30m we continue.

lee: I'll pre-warm the KV cache and do a small perf probe beforehand.

deploy-bot: feature-flag: routing_v3_client set for cohort client_canary_1 pct=1 by maria.
```
curl -s -X POST https://flags.redwood/api/v1/toggle \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FLAGS_TOKEN' \ 
  -d '{"flag":"routing_v3_client","cohort":"client_canary_1","pct":1}'
```

sre-oncall: Added temporary qps cap 500 for routing_v3 to avoid cascades while canary is active. Will watch for backpressure.

(deploy in-progress — 8m)

deploy-bot: Telemetry snapshot for cohort client_canary_1: p95=120ms, error_rate=0.9x baseline. Proceeding to pct=5.

maria: moving to 5%.

(deploy in-progress — 18m)

deploy-bot: ALERT: cohort client_canary_1 error_rate=1.9x baseline, p95=180ms. Automated rollout pause triggered.

sam: Pause confirmed. Hold further ramp. Can we pin active users back to v2 and kill new routing_v3 traffic?

maria: Executing fast toggle for that cohort.

deploy-bot: feature-flag: routing_v3_client cohort client_canary_1 pct=0 set by maria. Rollback toggles applied. Deploy job paused at stage=group-2.
```
# manual rollback command executed by maria
POST /flags/toggle {"flag":"routing_v3_client","cohort":"client_canary_1","pct":0}
```

lee: Observed mismatch in session lookup after failover — KV eviction caused stale pin mapping for a subset. Looks like a cache TTL bug under v3 session load.

jonah: Noted — will capture logs and open a follow-up: root cause looks like eviction + different shard hashing in v3.

ops: Will we need a hotfix or revert the code?

maria: For now revert traffic and pause release. Next steps: reproduce in staging with KV pressure, then decide between patching TTL vs revert. I'll add this to release notes and flag the rollout as blocked until we fix.

sre-oncall: Good call. Leaving qps cap in place until we validate. Will monitor for any residual 5xxs.

sam: Thanks all — glad auto-pause worked. Please @mention me on the postmortem PR. :thumbsup:

maria: Will do. Opening an issue and assigning owners. Closing this thread for now — tracking in #incidents once we have a postmortem. :eyes:
